January, February, March

The paragraph presents several legal issues regarding the enforceability of the non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and the validity of the termination. First, the absence of a witness during the signing of the NDA raises questions about the formalities required for contract execution, although witness presence is not universally mandatory for NDAs depending on jurisdiction and specific contract terms. Second, Alex’s claim of unawareness of the restrictions suggests potential issues with mutual assent or informed consent, which are fundamental elements of a valid contract. If Alex can prove they did not have actual or constructive notice of the NDA’s terms, the agreement may be deemed unenforceable. Finally, the termination itself may be challenged as wrongful if the NDA is found to be invalid or if the employer failed to follow proper procedural steps in enforcing the agreement.
